mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_map (group_id, name, description, cover_image, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, name, description, cover_image, created_at, updated_at FROM shared_map WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, group_id, name, description, cover_image, created_at, updated_at FROM shared_map WHERE group_id = #{groupId} LIMIT 1

SELECT sm.id, sm.name, sm.description, sm.cover_image AS coverImage, cg.visibility, mm.role AS myRole, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM map_member WHERE map_id = sm.id) AS memberCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM map_place WHERE map_id = sm.id) AS placeCount, sm.created_at AS createdAt FROM shared_map sm INNER JOIN map_member mm ON mm.map_id = sm.id AND mm.user_id = #{userId} INNER JOIN campus_group cg ON cg.id = sm.group_id ORDER BY sm.updated_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM map_member WHERE map_id = #{mapId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM map_place WHERE map_id = #{mapId}
